title: War?
content: Has anyone else been having more militaristic Mall World dreams? I've been having to do extra training. Running from people more often. And last night in my dream there was and announced meant that Russia just started a new war. It wasn't just me seeing it on TV or something. It's like everything in the dream that was happening just stopped and everyone around me was talking about it to each other independently. I can't stop thinking about it now.
